يستعبدوا (form X)
# يَسْتَعْبِدُوا (yastaʕbidū) /jas.taʕ.bi.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# يُسْتَعْبَدُوا (yustaʕbadū) /jus.taʕ.ba.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
